description:
Vita Sallas

Our brazilian team is made up of people who are passionate about technology, space exploration, innovation, and web development. Our goal is to use programming and creativity to transform ideas into digital solutions that contribute to solving the challenges proposed by NASA. We are interested in creating modern, intuitive, responsive, and accessible websites that present scientific information in a clear, interactive, and engaging way.

We aim to develop our skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, interface design, data organization, and teamwork. We believe that bringing together different skills, perspectives, and ideas is essential to creating high-quality projects and overcoming complex challenges.

Joining our team is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience, share knowledge, develop new skills, and collaborate on a project with a scientific and technological purpose. We value creativity, communication, commitment, curiosity, and a willingness to learn, regardless of each participant's level of experience.
